source_set_format: sha256 two spaces leaf-relative file LF, sorted over five listed files; report/log excluded
chosen_scope: Original logical interrupt-source option: allocation bitmap, masking, explicit fake MSI messages, coalesced pending bits, bounded single-source acknowledgement and vector-number routing in ordinary host RAM.

provenance.MIT_facts: PHY CTRL offset0 clock REQ/ACK bits0..3 and T8103 reset bit7; PORT_STATUS0x804 RUN bit0; LINKSTS0x208 UP/BUSY/L2 bits0/2/6.
provenance.source_gap: Pinned MIT pcie.c does not establish T8103 MSI register acknowledgement/initialization. Its T602X/T6031 MSIMAP path is not used or generalized. No numeric T8103 MSI register layout or write order is invented.
provenance.implementation: Original source rewritten from readiness facts and selected saved ADT metadata. No upstream implementation/comments/tables copied; no GPL file including pcie-apple.c was read or pasted for this slice. Original project licensing remains pending.

observed_metadata_binding.method: Offline AST-extracted pure parse_adt function only, no transport imports or hardware survey. Selected numeric properties independently decoded this turn.
observed_metadata_binding.profile: Message address0xfffff000, data0..7, synthetic target RID0x100, arithmetic AIC number704+vector. This does not certify physical route/ownership or IRQ delivery.

contract.guards: Checked explicit BCM fake accessor; first PHY0 masked0x8f must equal0x0f, then RUN, LINK UP/nonBUSY/nonL2, PCI14e4:4425, final PHY recheck. A reset/clock refusal makes no port read.
contract.zero_write_refusals: For every step, entry-down/reset/clock-not-ready or guard I/O error leaves the entire logical source file and output values byte-identical. No register writer exists even in admitted fake mode.
contract.late_reset: Final PHY recheck catches a reset introduced during the sampled read sequence. Caller serialization keeps the fake stable during the following CPU update; no atomic real-hardware guard claim.
contract.allocation: Only a nonzero bitmap within port0 bits0..7; initial allocated sources all masked and pending empty. Foreign vectors, high/other doorbell addresses and other endpoint identities refuse.
contract.receive: Explicit fake message argument only, no real MSI store. Masked events remain pending, repeated same-vector messages coalesce; received count is not delivery count.
contract.dispatch: One eligible allocated unmasked pending bit, lowest vector first; clears only that fake bit and returns vector/AIC arithmetic outputs. EMPTY changes neither file nor output values.
contract.cleanup: Close requires all allocated sources masked and no pending bits; no discard, implicit handler drain or hardware quiescence claim. Closed source cannot reopen, counters cannot wrap.
contract.lifetime: Synchronous caller-owned serialized state; no callback/thread/IRQ handler/scheduler. Accessor/source/profile/output stable and nonaliasing; not a C-code sandbox.
contract.default_kernel: All six operations return BMI_GATED with zero I/O and zero buffer changes. KERNEL+BMI_FAKE_DEVICE or shared PHY/PMGR write escape macro compile-refused. GPIO152 and SMC flags remain compiled out.
contract.not_a_driver: No IOPCIMessagedInterruptController/AIC registration, hardware MSI capability programming, status W1C, IRQ dispatch callback, DMA or actual delivery. All mask/pending/ack fields are model fields only.

cases: All6 operations refuse reset0x8f/reset0x80/missingACK/link0/RUN0/BUSY/L2 without logical file or output changes
Initial PHY refusal precedes port reads; late PHY reset rechecked
Every5-read guard position fails independently for every API without partial logical update
Foreign PCI identity, vector counts/bases, unallocated/out-of-range data and noncanonical address refuse
Masked pending/coalesced arrivals, exact lowest-vector ordering and one-bit-only acknowledgement
Pending/unmasked cleanup refusal, masked-empty close, no reopen and no fabricated startup event
Invalid mask bool, aliased/null dispatch outputs, received/delivered/commit bounds
Default/KERNEL no I/O/state changes; negative builds and preprocessed no-I/O gates; raw register writer is an assertion trap never invoked
